interpretation: Labels come from explicit rules over generated templates, so native test scores show how well the rules were learned on unseen projects, tasks and behaviours. End-to-end benchmark results are the evidence about runtime security.

calibration_comparison.decision: The stacked logistic regression is the calibration layer, and fits on out-of-fold scores. Components are not separately rescaled.
